+class ParallelSpyAaplStrategies(QCAlgorithm):
+    """Two independent daily strategies with separately tracked share lots."""
+
+    MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD = 20
+
+    def Initialize(self):
+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.tickers = ["SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"]
+        self.symbols = {
+            ticker: self.AddEquity(ticker, Resolution.Daily).Symbol
+            for ticker in self.tickers
+        }
+
+        self.spy_average = SimpleMovingAverage(self.MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD)
+        self.aapl_rsi = RelativeStrengthIndex(14, MovingAverageType.Wilders)
+
+        self.previous_spy_close = None
+        self.previous_spy_average = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+    def OnData(self, data: Slice):
+        bars = {
+            ticker: data.Bars[symbol]
+            for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items()
+            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol)
+        }
+
+        spy_bar = bars.get("SPY")
+        aapl_bar = bars.get("AAPL")
+
+        # State quantities continue to consume every available bar, even when a
+        # missing subscription prevents the strategy rules from being evaluated.
+        old_spy_close = self.previous_spy_close
+        old_spy_average = self.previous_spy_average
+        if spy_bar is not None:
+            self.spy_average.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_bar.Close)
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
+            if self.spy_average.IsReady:
+                self.previous_spy_average = self.spy_average.Current.Value
+
+        if aapl_bar is not None:
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            elif aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
+                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+            else:
+                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)
+
+        if len(bars) != len(self.symbols):
+            return
+
+        if not self.spy_average.IsReady or not self.aapl_rsi.IsReady:
+            return
+        if old_spy_close is None or old_spy_average is None:
+            return
+
+        spy_close = spy_bar.Close
+        spy_average = self.spy_average.Current.Value
+        spy_crossed_above = (
+            old_spy_close <= old_spy_average and spy_close > spy_average
+        )
+        spy_crossed_below = (
+            old_spy_close >= old_spy_average and spy_close < spy_average
+        )
+
+        # Sells are evaluated before buys on every fully formed bar.
+        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_crossed_below:
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.spy_lot)
+            self.spy_lot = 0
+
+        if self.aapl_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
+            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.aapl_lot)
+            self.aapl_lot = 0
+
+        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_crossed_above:
+            quantity = floor(0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy_close)
+            if quantity > 0:
+                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)
+                self.spy_lot = quantity
+
+        if self.aapl_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
+            cash_amount = 20_000
+            if self.Portfolio.Cash >= cash_amount:
+                quantity = floor(cash_amount / aapl_bar.Close)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)
+                    self.aapl_lot = quantity

+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)

+        self.previous_spy_sma = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.spy_lot = 0
+        self.aapl_lot = 0
+        self.spy_order_pending = False
+        self.aapl_order_pending = False
+        self.order_purposes = {}
+
+    def OnData(self, data):
+        bars = {}
+        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
+            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
+                bars[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]
+
+        spy = bars.get("SPY")
+        current_spy_sma = None
+        if spy is not None:
+            self.spy_sma.Update(spy.EndTime, spy.Close)
+            if self.spy_sma.IsReady:
+                current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value
+

+        if aapl is not None:
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:
+                if aapl.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl.EndTime, aapl.Close)
+
+        complete_day = len(bars) == len(self.symbols)
+        indicators_ready = (
+            current_spy_sma is not None
+            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
+            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
+            and self.previous_aapl_close is not None
+            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
+        )
+
+        if complete_day and indicators_ready:
+            spy_crossed_below = (
+                self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
+                and spy.Close < current_spy_sma
+            )
+            spy_crossed_above = (
+                self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
+                and spy.Close > current_spy_sma
+            )
+
+            # Every strategy's sell rule is evaluated before either buy rule.
+            if self.spy_lot > 0 and not self.spy_order_pending and spy_crossed_below:
+                self._submit_order("SPY", -self.spy_lot, "spy_sell")
+
+            if (
+                self.aapl_lot > 0
+                and not self.aapl_order_pending
+                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
+            ):
+                self._submit_order("AAPL", -self.aapl_lot, "aapl_sell")
+
+            if self.spy_lot == 0 and not self.spy_order_pending and spy_crossed_above:
+                quantity = floor(0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue / spy.Close)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self._submit_order("SPY", quantity, "spy_buy")
+
+            if (
+                self.aapl_lot == 0
+                and not self.aapl_order_pending
+                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
+                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
+            ):
+                quantity = floor(20_000 / aapl.Close)
+                if quantity > 0:
+                    self._submit_order("AAPL", quantity, "aapl_buy")
+
+        if spy is not None and current_spy_sma is not None:
+            self.previous_spy_close = spy.Close
+            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma
+        if aapl is not None:
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl.Close
+
+    def _submit_order(self, ticker, quantity, purpose):
+        if ticker == "SPY":
+            self.spy_order_pending = True
+        else:
+            self.aapl_order_pending = True
+        ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.symbols[ticker], quantity, False, purpose)
+        self.order_purposes[ticket.OrderId] = purpose
+
+    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
+        purpose = self.order_purposes.get(order_event.OrderId)
+        if purpose is None:
+            return
+
+        if order_event.Status in (OrderStatus.PartiallyFilled, OrderStatus.Filled):
+            if purpose.startswith("spy_"):
+                self.spy_lot += order_event.FillQuantity
+            else:
+                self.aapl_lot += order_event.FillQuantity
+
+        if order_event.Status in (
+            OrderStatus.Filled,
+            OrderStatus.Canceled,
+            OrderStatus.Invalid,
+        ):
+            if purpose.startswith("spy_"):
+                self.spy_order_pending = False
+                self.spy_lot = max(0, self.spy_lot)
+            else:
+                self.aapl_order_pending = False
+                self.aapl_lot = max(0, self.aapl_lot)
+            del self.order_purposes[order_event.OrderId]

        self.spy_lot = 0
        self.aapl_lot = 0

        # The extra SPY observation is required to compare both today's and
        # yesterday's close with the corresponding fully formed average.
        self.SetWarmUp(self.SPY_MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD + 1, Resolution.Daily)

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}
        complete_day = True
        for ticker, symbol in self.symbols.items():
            if not data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol):
                complete_day = False
                continue
            bars[ticker] = data.Bars[symbol]

        # Update every market-state quantity for each bar that is present,
        # even though an incomplete slice is never allowed to trigger a rule.
        spy_bar = bars.get("SPY")
        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_closes.append(float(spy_bar.Close))

        aapl_bar = bars.get("AAPL")
        if aapl_bar is not None:
            aapl_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
            if self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
                if aapl_close < self.aapl_previous_close:
                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
                else:
                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            self.aapl_previous_close = aapl_close
            self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if self.IsWarmingUp or not complete_day:
            return

        spy_ready = len(self.spy_closes) == self.spy_closes.maxlen
        aapl_ready = self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

        # Sells are evaluated before buys. Each branch can only manage its own
        # private lot; the two slots otherwise run independently in parallel.
        if self.spy_lot > 0 and spy_ready and self._spy_crosses_below_average():
            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], -self.spy_lot)
            self.spy_lot = 0

            self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], -self.aapl_lot)
            self.aapl_lot = 0

        if self.spy_lot == 0 and spy_ready and self._spy_crosses_above_average():
            close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            quantity = floor(0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / close)

                self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["SPY"], quantity)

                    self.MarketOrder(self.symbols["AAPL"], quantity)

        closes = list(self.spy_closes)
        yesterday_close = closes[-2]
        today_close = closes[-1]

        today_average = sum(closes[1:]) / self.SPY_MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD

+    MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD = 20

+        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
+        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
+        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
+
+        self.symbols = {}
+        for ticker in ("SPY", "AAPL", "IBM", "BAC", "AIG"):
+            self.symbols[ticker] = self.AddEquity(
+                ticker, Resolution.Daily
+            ).Symbol
+
+        self.spy_closes = deque(maxlen=self.MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD)
+        self.previous_spy_relation = None
+        self.previous_aapl_close = None
+        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+
+        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(
+            self.symbols["AAPL"],
+            14,
+            MovingAverageType.Wilders,
+            Resolution.Daily,
+        )
+
+        self.strategy_a_shares = 0
+        self.strategy_b_shares = 0
+
+        self.SetWarmUp(self.MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD + 1, Resolution.Daily)
+

+        spy = self.symbols["SPY"]
+        aapl = self.symbols["AAPL"]
+
+        spy_crossed_above = False
+        spy_crossed_below = False
+
+        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(spy):
+            spy_close = data.Bars[spy].Close
+            self.spy_closes.append(spy_close)
+
+            if len(self.spy_closes) == self.MOVING_AVERAGE_PERIOD:
+                moving_average = sum(self.spy_closes) / len(self.spy_closes)
+                current_relation = spy_close - moving_average
+
+                if self.previous_spy_relation is not None:
+                    spy_crossed_above = (
+                        self.previous_spy_relation <= 0
+                        and current_relation > 0
+                    )
+                    spy_crossed_below = (
+                        self.previous_spy_relation >= 0
+                        and current_relation < 0
+                    )
+
+                self.previous_spy_relation = current_relation
+
+        if data.Bars.ContainsKey(aapl):
+            aapl_close = data.Bars[aapl].Close
+            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None:

+                    self.aapl_red_streak += 1
+                else:
+                    self.aapl_red_streak = 0
+            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

+                self.MarketOrder(spy, shares)
